documented_probe: C-3f9a7c11 (reverse-complement / strand-orientation reasoning on nucleotide sequences): the covering task exercises it at hard — a misoriented or misordered reverse primer fails every hidden case. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Single-stage hard task: QuikChange-style centered mutagenic primer design over a possibly multi-record FASTA template with variable-length inserts (substitution/insertion/deletion), whole-primer Wallace Tm and GC windows, a three-level tie-break, and a strict ordered error taxonomy. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (strand orientation, 2-D flank search), debugging_ambiguity (tie-break precision), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (six hidden scenes incl. error tokens), and quantitative_correctness (exact sequences, integral Tm, rounded GC). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
